beats.say: Now the defence. One. A moat built on a founder's energy is fragile, and even Mrs. B got the carpet department wrong. Two. Furniture retail is local, so every new city means huge new stores and land. Three. Low cost moats need constant discipline. One lazy generation, and costs creep up. And four.
